name: System Stats
author: Florian Hessling
description: CPU and memory usage in the bar, read straight from procfs, with a detail panel for per-core load, memory, swap, load average and the busiest processes.

barWidget.description: CPU and memory usage with sparklines, and a panel with per-core load, memory, swap, load average and top processes.

schema.label: Sample interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the bar readout samples /proc. This is also the averaging window for the CPU percentage.

schema.label: Panel sample interval (ms)
schema.description: Faster sampling while the panel is open.

schema.label: Show per-core load in the panel
Top processes in the panel
schema.description: Set to 0 to drop the process list, which is the only thing in this plugin that runs a subprocess.

schema.label: Alert threshold (%)
schema.description: Usage at or above this turns the readout and its chart the alert color.

schema.label: Chart color
schema.description: Theme token for sparklines and core meters below the alert threshold: a role name (accent, urgent, muted, foreground), any shell.toml key such as hyprland.active-border, or a hex value. Leave empty to use the theme's [stats] chart key, falling back to accent.

schema.label: Chart alert color
schema.description: Theme token for sparklines at or above the alert threshold. Leave empty to use the theme's [stats] chart-alert key, falling back to urgent.

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Run on right-click. Leave empty to disable.
